steps.title: A zaɓi abu sananne
steps.text: Hotunan kofin shayi, lambu, dabbobin gida da jiragen ruwa. Babu karatu ko ƙa’idojin da za a koya da farko.

steps.title: A zauna kusa da juna
steps.text: Ku bar shi ko ita ya taɓa. Ku yi magana a kan hotunan. Hoton da bai yi daidai ba yana jira taɓawa ta gaba kawai.

steps.title: A tsaya yayin da yake da daɗi
steps.text: Wasa ɗaya cikakken aiki ne. “Ya isa a yanzu” yana nan a allo a koyaushe.

home.stageLede: Kiɗa, ayyukan yau da kullum, tuna abubuwan da suka wuce da lokutan natsuwa na hankulan jiki, an daidaita su da abin da ke da daɗi a yanzu.

stages.title: Mataki na farko
stages.text: A ci gaba da abin da suke so, da ƙananan gyare-gyare: sha’awa, fita yawo, wasannin kalmomi da shiri tare.

stages.title: Mataki na tsakiya
stages.text: Ayyuka masu sauƙi da sanannu da aka raba zuwa matakai: naɗe kaya, rarrabewa, kiɗa, wasannin hotuna da gajerun yawo.
stages.label: Shawarwarin mataki na tsakiya

stages.title: Mataki na ƙarshe

stages.label: Shawarwarin mataki na ƙarshe

home.specificHtml: Kuna neman wani abu na musamman? Gwada ayyuka da wasanni ga masu cutar Alzheimer, wasanin gwada ilimi da wasannin teburi, wasannin tattaunawa ko wasanin gwada ilimi.

home.researchText: Za a iya hana mantuwa? Shin wasannin ƙwaƙwalwa suna taimakawa? Me game da azumi, abinci, barci da ji? Amsoshi masu sauƙi da madogara, har da inda shaida take da rauni.
home.appTitle: Creative Activities a iPhone, iPad da Android
home.appText: Manhajar kyauta tana aiki ba tare da intanet ba, kuma tana iya amfani da hotunan iyali da kuka zaɓa, ana ajiye su a matsayin kwafi a na’urarku. Zane iri ɗaya mai natsuwa: manyan katuna huɗu, babu agogo, babu maki.

faq.q: Wane wasanni ne masu kyau ga tsofaffi?
faq.a: Wasanni masu kyau sun kasance masu sauƙi, sanannu kuma marasa matsi: hotuna manya da za a haɗa, rabe-rabe, wasan wasanin gwada ilimi masu sauƙi, kammala karin magana sanannu, launi, bingo na hotuna da katunan tattaunawa. Sun dace da tsofaffi da yawa, ciki har da masu rayuwa da cutar mantuwa. Zaɓin da ya fi dacewa shi ne wanda mutum ke jin daɗinsa a yau. A guji agogo, maki da duk abin da ke kama da jarrabawa.
Eh. Kowane wasa da abin bugawa a Creative Activities kyauta ne, ba tare da asusu, rajista ko saukewa ba. Wasannin suna aiki a burauzar yanar gizo a waya, tablet ko kwamfuta.

Babu wani wasa da aka nuna yana hana cutar mantuwa, kuma Creative Activities ba ya ikirarin warkarwa ko hana wata cuta. Wasanninmu don jin daɗi ne da lokacin tare, kuma babu shafin aiki da ke yin ikirarin lafiya.

faq.q: Waɗannan wasannin sun dace da mai cutar Alzheimer?
faq.a: Eh. Cutar Alzheimer ita ce ta fi haddasa mantuwa, kuma an yi wasannin don ita: manyan hotuna da ke nan a bayyane, zaɓi kaɗan, kuma babu abin da za a tuna ko a yi kuskure a kai. Haɗawa, rarrabewa da kammala karin magana sananne suna dogara ne da ilimin da aka daɗe ana da shi, ba sabon koyo ba.

faq.q: Mai mantuwa a mataki na ƙarshe zai iya amfani da waɗannan ayyuka?
faq.a: Sau da yawa eh, tare da wani kusa da shi. Ku fara da “Nemo iri ɗaya” da hotuna biyu, “Haɗa hotuna biyu-biyu” da katuna huɗu, shafin canza launi ko ɗan hutun numfashi mai natsuwa. Ku taƙaita, ku bi abin da suke so, ku tsaya idan sun isa.

Shafin ba shi da asusu ko talla. Muna amfani da Google Analytics don fahimtar shafukan da ake ziyarta. Hotunan da kuka zaɓa don Haɗa hotunan kanku ana nuna su a burauzarku kaɗai kuma ba a taɓa aika su ba.

Creative Activities ƙaramar ƙungiya ce da ke yin ayyukan kirkira masu natsuwa ga manya, ga duk wanda ke kula da wani, a yanar gizo da kuma a matsayin manhaja kyauta. Ba mu ƙwararrun likitoci ba ne, kuma babu wani abu a nan da shawarar likita ce.

brain-health.description: Za a iya hana mantuwa? Jagorori masu gaskiya da madogara game da abubuwan da ke ƙara haɗarin mantuwa, wasannin ƙwaƙwalwa, azumi, abinci, barci da ji.
brain-health.lede: Abin da manyan bincike suke nunawa game da rage haɗarin mantuwa, a bayyane, har da inda shaida take da rauni ko gauraye. Bayani na gabaɗaya ne, ba shawarar likita ba.

guide.sourcesNote: Mun haɗa mahaɗa zuwa ƙungiyoyi da binciken da wannan shafi ya dogara da su. An duba kowanne lokacin da aka sabunta shafin.
guide.staleText: An yi ta ne daga sigar shafin Turanci da ta gabata, wanda tun daga lokacin ya canja. Shafin Turanci shi ne na yanzu.
guide.staleHealth: Yana ba da bayanan lafiya, don haka ku duba shafin Turanci kuma ku tambayi likita ko ma'aikacin jinya kafin ku aikata wani abu bisa gare shi.

healthNotice.title: Bayani na gabaɗaya, ba shawarar likita ba
healthNotice.textHtml: Wannan shafi yana taƙaita binciken da aka wallafa ga iyalai. Ba zai iya gaya muku abin da ya dace da mutum ɗaya ba. Ku yi magana da likita kafin canza abinci, motsa jiki, barci, magunguna ko kari. Idan akwai rikicewar tunani kwatsam ko wasu canje-canje kwatsam, ku nemi taimakon likita nan take. Ku karanta sanarwar bayanan lafiya namu.

about.description: Dalilin da ya sa Creative Activities ba shi da agogo, maki ko jerin nasarori, dalilin da ya sa hotuna ke ci gaba da bayyana, da abin da za mu yi da abin da ba za mu yi ikirari game da lafiya ba.

about.lede: Creative Activities yana yin ayyuka masu natsuwa da na manya waɗanda mutane biyu za su iya jin daɗinsu tare, ko ɗaya yana kula da ɗayan ko kuma suna son kawai su ciyar da lokaci tare.
about.bodyHtml:
Ga wa aka yi shi

Duk wanda ke kula da wani: uba ko uwa, kaka, yaro, abokin zama, aboki, ko wanda ke rayuwa da dementia. Iyalai, manya, da ma'aikatan ayyuka duk za su iya amfani da shafuka iri ɗaya.

Abin da muke imani da shi

Manufar aiki ita ce lokacin kansa: tattaunawa, murmushi, gamsuwar haɗa hotuna biyu, ko kawai zama kusa da juna. Ba don auna kowa ba ne, ko tura shi gaba, ko tabbatar da wani abu.

Yawancin manhajojin horar da kwakwalwa an tsara su ne a kan gudu, maki, jerin nasarori da matakai. Ga wanda ya gaji, ba shi da lafiya, ko yana rayuwa da dementia, hakan na iya zama kamar jarrabawar da ba zai iya ci ba. Mun tsara akasin haka, kuma muna riƙe kanmu ga waɗannan dokoki:

  • Babu abin da za a kasa. Babu agogo, maki, ma'aunin motsi, rayuka, jerin nasarori, ko lokacin ƙidaya, a kowane allo.
  • Gane fiye da tunowa. Hotuna suna ci gaba da bayyana ta tsoho. Tambayoyi suna gayyatar tattaunawa kuma ba sa jarraba sunaye ko tunani.
  • Manya, a sarari, kuma tsayayye. Rubutu da hotuna masu girma, bambanci mai ƙarfi, da maɓallai da suke zama a wuri ɗaya.
  • Mutunci na manya. Hotunan rayuwa ta gaske da kalmomi a sarari, masu dumi. Babu zane mai ban dariya, yabo irin na waƙa, ko lada da emoji.
  • Hanyar fita cikin sauƙi. “An gama yanzu” koyaushe yana bayyane. Tsayawa a tsakiya sakamako ne mai kyau.
  • Sirri ta tsoho. Babu asusu ko talla. Hotunan da kuka zaɓa suna zama a na'urarku.

Abin da ba mu ikirari ba

Wasanninmu da ayyukanmu don jin daɗi ne da haɗin kai. Ba sa tantancewa, gwadawa, aunawa, magance, rage, ko hana dementia ko cutar Alzheimer, kuma babu wanda ya kamata ya zaɓe su don hakan. Idan muka rubuta game da binciken lafiya, muna faɗin a sarari inda shaidar take da rauni, kuma ba mu taɓa haɗa shi da ayyukanmu ba.

Su wane ne mu

Creative Activities ƙaramar ƙungiya ce mai zaman kanta. Ba mu ma'aikatan lafiya ba ne. Jagororinmu an rubuta su ne daga shawarwarin da aka buga daga ƙungiyoyi irin su National Institute on Aging da Alzheimer's Association, kuma kowane jagora yana lissafa majiyoyinsa. Karanta yadda muke rubutawa da duba shafukanmu.

Ku gaya mana abin da zai taimaka

Za mu so jin abin da ke aiki a gare ku da abin da ba ya aiki, musamman daga mutanen da ke rayuwa da dementia, masu kula da iyali, da ma'aikatan ayyuka. Aika imel zuwa {email}.

editorial.title: Yadda Muke Rubutu da Duba Shafukanmu
editorial.description: Yadda Creative Activities ke bincike, rubutu, samo bayanai da sabunta shafukan ayyukanta da na lafiya, da abin da ba za mu taɓa bugawa ba.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

faq.title: Tambayoyi da Amsoshi
faq.seoTitle: Tambayoyi da Amsoshi Game da Creative Activities
faq.description: Amsoshin tambayoyin da aka saba yi game da wasanni da ayyuka: waɗanne za a gwada, tsawon lokacin wasa, ƙungiyoyi da ra'ayoyi na mataki na gaba, lafiya da sirri.
faq.lede: Gajerun amsoshi masu sauƙi ga tambayoyin da masu kulawa suka fi yi.

items.q: Su waɗanne ne mafi kyawun wasanni ga manya?
items.a: Mafi kyawun wasanni sanannu ne, masu sauƙi kuma marasa matsin lamba, kuma wanda ya dace shi ne duk abin da mutumin ya ji daɗinsa a yau. Haɗa hotuna a bayyane, rarrabewa, wasannin haɗa guntaye masu sauƙi, kammala karin magana sananne, canza launi da bingo na hotuna duk suna dacewa da mutane da yawa. Ku guji agogo, maki da duk abin da yake kama da jarabawa.
Eh. Dukan wasanni da abubuwan bugawa kyauta ne, ba tare da asusu, rajista, saukewa ko talla ba.

items.q: Me ya sa babu maki, matakai ko agogo?
items.a: Gudu da maki suna mai da aiki mai daɗi zuwa jarabawa, wanda zai iya kawo kunya ko takaici. Muna mai da hankali ne kan jin daɗi da zama tare, don haka babu abin da za a fadi kuma kuna iya tsayawa a kowane lokaci.

items.q: Waɗanne na’urori ne suka fi dacewa?
items.a: Duk wata waya, tablet ko kwamfuta mai burauzar yanar gizo ta zamani. Tablet a kan stand a teburi sau da yawa ita ce hanya mafi daɗi ga mutum biyu su yi wasa kusa da juna. Laptop da aka haɗa da talabijin tana da kyau ga ƙungiya.

items.q: Za mu iya yin wasa da hotunan iyalinmu?
items.a: Eh. “Haɗa hotunan kanku” yana mai da hotuna 2 zuwa 6 da kuka zaɓa wasan haɗawa. Hotunan suna zama a burauzarku kuma ba a aika ko ajiye su ba.

items.q: Tsawon wane lokaci ya kamata aiki ya ɗauka?
items.a: Sau da yawa mintuna 10 zuwa 20 sun isa, kuma wani lokaci mintuna 2 nasara ne. Ku kula da alamun gajiya ko takaici ku tsaya yayin da yake da daɗi. Babu daidai adadi.

items.q: Idan ba sa son yin wani aiki fa?
items.a: Ku mutunta ƙin, ku sake gwadawa daga baya ko ta wata hanya. Ƙin na iya fitowa daga gajiya, ciwo, rashin tabbas ko rashin sha’awa kawai. Ku duba jagorarmu kan abin da za a yi idan sun ƙi.

items.q: Waɗanne ayyuka ne suka dace da mai mantuwa a mataki na ƙarshe?
items.a: Jin daɗi da hankulan jiki: sauraron kiɗan da suke so, tausa hannu da mai, kallon hotuna tare, riƙe bargo mai laushi, zama a waje, ko wasan hotuna mai sauƙi sosai tare da wani kusa da su. Jagorarmu ta mataki na ƙarshe tana da ƙarin shawarwari da yawa.

items.q: Akwai ayyuka ga ƙungiyoyi a gidan kula da tsofaffi?
items.a: Eh. Bingo na hotuna yana da katunan bugawa da mai kira a allo, kuma “Kammala karin magana” da “Katunan hira” suna da kyau idan ana karanta su da murya. Jagorarmu ta ƙungiyoyin gidan kulawa tana magana kan girman ƙungiya, wurin zama da daidaita ga mabambantan iyawa.

items.q: Wasanni za su iya hana ko rage mantuwa?
items.a: A’a. Ba a nuna cewa wani wasa yana hana mantuwa ba, kuma wasanninmu ba su yin irin wannan iƙirari. Ƙarfafa tunani a yanayin zamantakewa ya nuna ƙananan fa’idodi a bincike ga masu mantuwa mai sauƙi zuwa matsakaici, amma wannan ya bambanta da wasa yana hana cuta. Muna ba da wasanni don jin daɗi da haɗin kai.

Ba da tabbaci ba. Bincike ya danganta abubuwan lafiya da salon rayuwa 14 da haɗarin mantuwa, kamar rashin ji, hawan jini, rashin motsa jiki da kaɗaici. Magance su na iya rage haɗari ga wasu mutane, amma mutane da yawa da suke yin komai daidai suna kamuwa da mantuwa. Ba laifin kowa ba ne.

items.q: Azumi na lokaci-lokaci yana da amfani ga lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa?
items.a: Shaida a kan mutane tana da ƙaranci kuma tana farko, kuma yawancin binciken a kan dabbobi ne. Azumi na iya zama mai haɗari ga tsofaffi, musamman tare da magungunan ciwon sukari ko rage nauyi ba da gangan ba, kuma ba a ba da shawarar sa ga masu mantuwa ba. Ku yi magana da likita kafin canza yadda kuke ci.

Babu asusu ko talla. Muna amfani da Google Analytics don ƙirga ziyara da ganin shafukan da ke taimakawa, kuma burauzarku tana tunawa ko kun kunna sautuka masu taushi. Ba a taɓa aika hotunan da kuka zaɓa don Haɗa hotunan kanku ba. Ku duba sanarwar sirri don cikakkun bayanai.
A’a. Creative Activities don nishaɗi da bayani na gabaɗaya ne. Don tambayoyin lafiya, ku yi magana da likita, kuma don gaggawa ku kira lambar gaggawa ta yankinku.

faq.moreHtml: Ƙarin bayani: yadda ake wasa tare, lokacin da suka ce a'a, ayyuka na mataki na gaba da ayyukan dementia a gida.

handout.gamesTitle: Wasannin da za a gwada tare
handout.restHtml:
Wasu shawarwari

  • Ku zaɓi lokacin rana da mutumin yake a mafi kyawun halinsa.
  • Ku fara da mafi sauƙin saiti. Katuna huɗu sun isa.
  • Ku yi magana game da hotunan. Hirar sau da yawa ita ce mafi kyau.
  • Ku tsaya yayin da yake da daɗi. Ƙarewa da wuri sakamako ne mai kyau.

Akwai kuma a shafin

  • Abubuwan bugawa na kyauta: neman kalmomi da manyan haruffa, shafukan canza launi, katunan hira da bingo na hotuna.
  • Shawarwarin ayyuka ga kowane mataki, da jagorori kan wasa tare da kula da kanku.

Don jin daɗi da zama tare. Ba shawarar likita, gwaji ko magani ba. Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd. ne ya wallafa Creative Activities.

organizations.description: Yadda gidajen kulawa, shirye-shiryen kulawa na rana ga manya, ɗakunan karatu, hukumomin tsufa da ƙungiyoyin tallafi ke amfani da wasannin hotuna kyauta da jagororin ayyukanmu, tare da rubutu don saka mu a jerin albarkatu.
organizations.lede: Duk abin da ke wannan shafi kyauta ne don amfani da mazauna, mambobi da abokan ciniki, ba tare da asusu, lasisi ko kuɗi ba.
organizations.shortText: {name}: wasannin hotuna kyauta, masu sauƙi, da jagororin ayyuka ga manya, iyalai da mutanen da ke rayuwa da dementia. Babu rajista, babu agogo, babu maki.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) yana ba da wasanni {count} kyauta a burauza ga tsofaffi, iyalai da mutanen da ke rayuwa da cutar mantuwa. Wasannin sun haɗa da wasan nemo hotuna biyu-biyu inda hotunan suke a buɗe, wasan haɗa guntun hoto mai sauƙi, wasan rarraba abubuwa, sanannun karin magana, da bingo na hotuna tare da katunan da za a iya bugawa. Babu asusu, talla, agogo ko maki. Shafin kuma yana da jagororin ayyuka cikin harshe mai sauƙi ga iyalai, tsofaffi da ma'aikata, tare da majiyoyi kamar National Institute on Aging da Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.useTitle: Abin da ƙungiyoyi za su iya amfani da shi
organizations.gamesItemHtml: Wasannin burauza {count} da ke aiki a laptop, tablet ko talabijin da aka haɗa da kwamfuta. Babu shigarwa, asusu ko saukewa. Ku duba dukan wasanni.
organizations.printablesAfter: Ku yi amfani da maɓallin Print a kowane shafi.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Tsarin rukuni: Bingo na hotuna yana da katunan da za a iya bugawa da mai kiran lambobi a kan allo, kuma wasannin tattaunawa yana da tambayoyi tare da zaɓuɓɓukan amsa da batutuwan tattaunawa.
  • Jagororin ayyuka ga ma'aikata da iyalai, an rubuta su cikin harshe mai sauƙi tare da majiyoyi. Fara da ra'ayoyin ayyuka 101 ko ayyukan rukuni ga gidajen kulawa.
organizations.restHtml:
Yadda ƙungiyoyi suke amfani da shi

  • Gidajen kulawa da kulawar tunani: bingo na hotuna ko kammala karin magana a talabijin na ɗakin zama, tare da mutum ɗaya yana taɓawa don ƙungiyar.
  • Shirye-shiryen rana na manya: tashar tablet da Haɗa hotuna biyu-biyu a katuna huɗu, don gajerun zama ɗaya-ɗaya.
  • Ɗakunan karatu na jama’a: bugaggun neman kalmomi da katunan hira a cikin kayan tunani, da shafin a alamance a tablet ɗin ɗakin karatu.
  • Ƙungiyoyin tallafin masu kulawa da wuraren haɗuwa: takarda ɗaya ta bugawa da iyalai za su tafi da ita gida.
  • Asibitoci da masu shirya sallama: takardar a cikin jakar masu kulawa, don wani abu mai natsuwa da za a yi a gida ko a gadon asibiti.

Abin da ba ma yi

Wasannin don jin daɗi da zama tare ne. Ba sa tantancewa, gwadawa, ba da maki, magance ko rage mantuwa, kuma muna roƙon ƙungiyoyi kada su siffanta su haka. Babu talla, kuma wasannin ba sa tambayar sunaye, bayanan lafiya ko aika hotuna. Shafin yana amfani da Google Analytics don ƙirga ziyara; sanarwar sirrinmu tana bayyana abin da yake tattarawa. Hotunan da ake amfani da su a Haɗa hotunan kanku suna zama a burauza.

A ƙara mu cikin jerin albarkatunku

Idan kuna da jerin albarkatu ga masu kulawa, kuna maraba ku haɗa zuwa {domain}. Kuna iya kwafar ɗaya daga cikin bayanan guda biyu.
organizations.linksHtml:
Shafuka masu amfani da za a iya haɗawa kai tsaye: wasanni kyauta, takardun bugawa kyauta, ayyukan cutar mantuwa a gida da yadda ake wasa tare.

Tambayoyi ko gyara

Idan wani abu a shafin ba daidai ba ne ko ba a fayyace shi ba, ko kuma idan bukatun wani mazaunin gida ba a biya su da abin da ke nan ba, don Allah ku sanar da mu a {email}. Don Allah kada ku aika bayanan sirri ko na lafiya game da mazauna ko abokan ciniki.

app.title: Manhajar Creative Activities
app.seoTitle: Manhajar Creative Activities don iPhone da Android
app.description: Manhajar Creative Activities ta kyauta: haɗa hotuna a hankali da katuna huɗu manya, hotunan iyali da ake ajiyewa a na’urarku, tarin hotuna ba tare da intanet ba da babu.
app.lede: Duk abin da kuke so a shafin yanar gizo, a cikin manhaja da ke aiki ba tare da intanet ba kuma tana iya amfani da hotunan iyali da kuka zaɓa.
app.bodyHtml:
A fara da ƙanƙane

Ku fara da manyan katuna huɗu da sanannun hotuna. Ku bar hotuna a bayyane, ko ku ɓoye su idan hakan ya yi daɗi. Yanayin natsuwa ba shi da agogo, maki ko hukunci. Ku zaɓi katuna 4, 6, 8 ko 12.

A sa shi ya zama na ku

Ku zaɓi hotunan iyali da mai zaɓar hotuna na na’urarku. Manhajar tana ajiye ƙananan kwafi don ayyukanta. Ba ta bincika ɗakin hotunanku ko canza hotunanku na asali ba, kuma tana ajiye har hotuna 24 a tari ɗaya.

A kalla tare kawai

A duba hoto ɗaya a lokaci guda. Tambayoyi na zaɓi suna gayyatar hira ba tare da neman kowa ya tuna suna ko ya ba da amsa madaidaiciya ba. Kallo kawai ya isa.

Ba tare da intanet ba, a inda ya fi muhimmanci

Hotunan farko da dukan tarin hotuna takwas suna cikin manhajar. Kwafin hotunan da aka shigo da su suna aiki ba tare da intanet ba. Zaɓar hotunan asali da aka ajiye a iCloud kaɗai na iya buƙatar intanet.

Babu asusu, babu sabar raba hoto

Kwafin hotunan iyali suna zama a cikin manhajar a na’urar. Kuna iya cire kwafin ba tare da goge hotunan asali ba. Ajiyar bayanan na’ura na iya haɗawa da bayanan manhaja. Ku karanta manufar sirrin manhaja, kuma taimakon manhaja yana bi da ku mataki-mataki.
app.disclaimer: Creative Activities don nishaɗi da hira tare ne. Ba ta tantancewa, ba ta yin magani, ba ta hana, kuma ba ta auna cutar mantuwa ko cutar Alzheimer ba.

faq.q: Wane wasa ya kamata mu fara da shi?
faq.a: Haɗa hotuna biyu-biyu da katuna huɗu zaɓi ne mai natsuwa na farko. Idan zaɓar tsakanin hotuna ya yi yawa, ku gwada “Nemo iri ɗaya” da hotuna biyu. Ga ƙungiya, ku gwada Bingo na hotuna.

faq.q: Wasannin suna aiki a iPad ko waya?
faq.a: Eh. Kowane wasa yana aiki a burauza a waya, tablet da kwamfuta, kuma hotuna suna girma su cika allo. Tablet a kan stand sau da yawa ita ce ta fi daɗi ga mutum biyu.

faq.q: Waɗannan wasannin suna da kyau ga mai cutar Alzheimer?
faq.a: Eh. An yi su ne don masu rayuwa da mantuwa, har da Alzheimer, wacce ta fi haddasa ta. Hotuna suna nan a bayyane, zaɓi kaɗan ne, kuma babu abin da aka sa wa lokaci ko maki, don haka wasannin suna dogara ne da gane sanannun abubuwa, ba tuna sababbi ba.

faq.q: Waɗannan wasannin tunani ne ga tsofaffi?
faq.a: Wasannin nemo hotuna ne da sauran wasannin hotuna da kowane tsoho zai iya morewa, amma an tsara su ba don gwada ƙwaƙwalwa ba: a wasan Nemo hotuna biyu-biyu, hotunan suna nan a buɗe sai dai idan kun zaɓi akasin haka. Kowane wasan ƙwaƙwalwa za a iya sa shi ya zama mai sauƙi ta hanyar cire agogo da maki.

faq.q: Akwai wasanni ga ƙungiyoyi a gidan kulawa?
faq.a: Eh. Bingo na hotuna yana da katunan bugawa da mai kira a allo, kuma “Kammala karin magana” da “Katunan hira” suna da kyau idan aka karanta wa ƙungiya da murya.

print.heading: Wasa a takarda
print.sameRules: Sigar takarda tana da dokoki iri ɗaya da wasan da ke kan allo:
print.pageNote: Shafi ɗaya a girman A4 ko US Letter, yana da kyau a baƙi da fari. Sigar {date}.
print.islandNote: Yana buga abin da ke kan allo a yanzu. Sigar {date}.
print.point: A takarda, nuna hoto maimakon taɓa shi, ko zagaye shi da alƙalami. Kowane layi sabon saiti ne.
print.pointTarget: A takarda, hoton da za a duba yana cikin akwatin a farkon kowane layi. Nuna hoto maimakon taɓa shi, ko zagaye shi da alƙalami.
print.halves: Kowane hoto an yanke shi a tsakiya. Zana layi daga kowane rabi a hagu zuwa rabin da ya dace da shi a dama, ko nuna da yatsa. Babu buƙatar yanke komai.
print.grid: Kowane murabba'i yana da lamba. Nemo wannan lamba a jerin alamomi, sannan ku fenti murabba'in da fensir mai launin da aka ambata. Kowane launi da kuke so shi ma yana da kyau. Babu buƙatar yanke komai.
print.colors: Kowane layi yana ambaton launi. Nuna kowane hoto mai wannan launi, ko zagaye shi da alƙalami. Kowane layi sabon saiti ne.
print.dice: Kowane layi saitin dice ne. Zaɓi layi, ko ku yanke hotunan ku ɗauko wasu daga tari, sannan ku ba da labari ta amfani da su a kowane tsari. Duk wanda ke so zai iya wucewa.
print.words: Yanke kalmomin, ko zana layi daga kowace kalma zuwa hotonta. Karanta kalmomin da ƙarfi yayin da kuke tafiya.
print.cards: Yanke katunan tare da layukan ɗigo. Shimfiɗa su a buɗe a kan tebur, sannan ku nemo biyu-biyu.
print.chain: A takarda, karanta hotuna daga hagu zuwa dama, ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowane mutum ya faɗi jumla ɗaya game da hotunan da suka zo yanzu, sannan ya nuna hoto na gaba. Duk wanda ke so zai iya wucewa.
print.sort: Yanke hotunan tare da layukan ɗigo, sannan ku saka kowane hoto a akwatin da ya dace da shi.
print.puzzle: Yanke babban hoto tare da layukan ɗigo zuwa guda huɗu, sannan ku haɗa su. Musanya guda biyu a lokaci ɗaya har hoton ya cika. Ƙaramin hoton jagora ne.
print.cutSafety: Mataimaki zai iya yin yankan kafin ku fara. Bayan haka, ajiye almakashi.

reasons.photos: Babu sigar takarda. Wannan wasa yana amfani da hotunanku, waɗanda ke zama a burauzarku kuma ba a taɓa lodawa ba, don haka shafin ba zai iya buga su ba. Don yin wasa a takarda, buga kwafi biyu na 'yan hotunan da kuka fi so a gida, sannan ku haɗa su a kan tebur.
reasons.paced: Babu sigar takarda. Da'irar tana saita tafiya a hankali kuma a daidai gwargwado a kan allo, kuma shafin da aka buga ba zai iya yin hakan ba, don haka zai zama wani aiki daban. Hutu natsuwa tare ba tare da allo ba koyaushe zaɓi ne.
reasons.turns: Babu sigar takarda ga wannan wasan. Don nemo biyu-biyu a kan tebur, buga katunan hotuna daga wasan Nemo hotuna biyu-biyu, sannan ku riƙa juya su a jere.
reasons.screen: Ba a samunsa a takarda ba. Hoto ne da za ku kalla tare a allo; hoton da kuka fi so ko katin gaisuwa a kan teburi yana yin aikin iri ɗaya.
reasons.wash: Ba a samunsa a takarda ba. Zanen ruwa a kan takarda ra'ayi ɗaya ne: goga mai jika da launi ɗaya a lokaci guda.
reasons.sayings: Ba a samunsa a takarda ba tukuna. A takarda, kowane ƙarshe zai bayyana lokaci ɗaya, kuma matakin nan a hankali "Nuna ƙarshen" zai ɓace. Ku karanta maganganun tare daga allo, ko ku raba wasu kaɗan da kuka san su duka.
